crossRefs.note: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.
translations.bsb: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.
translations.kjv: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
